subject: Supplemental cohort credit & billing flexibility request
messages:
From: Ava Nguyen <ava@pioneerlabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplemental credits for Pioneer Labs founders cohort

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency and cost story. We're onboarding a small founders cohort the week of July 12 and are trying to align infrastructure credits so teams can iterate without immediate spend.

We currently have a promotional sandbox credit from your launch program (~$2k) but usage projections show several teams will hit that within a month. Is there a path to request a one-time supplemental credit for the cohort (additional $5k–$10k), and/or a temporary billing grace (30–45 days) while we ramp?

High-level: 8 teams, avg expected monthly usage per team 30–40k tokens, ramp to steady-state by month 2. We have a quick legal review window next week so if there's a short term-sheet or approval process we can expedite.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Best,
Ava Nguyen
Head of Programs, Pioneer Labs
ava@pioneerlabs.com

Attachment: usage_snapshot_202705.csv (preview of expected consumption)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava@pioneerlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental credits for Pioneer Labs founders cohort

Hi Ava — great to hear the demo resonated. Congrats on the cohort launch.

Short answer: yes, we can usually make a one-time supplemental credit exception for early-stage cohorts, and we do have a short approval path for billing grace when tied to ramp metrics. I copied Vanessa (Program Ops) for policy and Karthik for pricing guardrails.

To speed this up, can you: 1) confirm total supplemental amount requested ($5k vs $10k), 2) share a quick target date for when teams will first exceed the sandbox credit, and 3) confirm billing contact for contract/PO (if any)? Vanessa — quick read: Pioneer looks like a good fit for a one-time top-up + 30-day invoice deferral while teams ramp. Any operational constraints we should note?

I can put together a short term sheet if that helps (1‑page, credit amount, usage cap, expiry).

—Mateo
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ava Nguyen <ava@pioneerlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental credits for Pioneer Labs founders cohort

Thanks for the context. Quick operational notes:

- We can approve one-time promotional top-ups up to $10k for accelerators/cohorts on the launch program. Approvals require: a short approval note from AE + expected usage snapshot (we have that).
- Billing grace: standard is 30 days for cohort partners; we can extend to 45 days on a case-by-case basis if there's a commitment to convert to paid plans by month 3.
- Controls: supplemental credits are timeboxed (90 days) and applied to the account at an org level, not per-team. Any overages are billed at standard rates unless you request an overage hold (we rarely do permanent holds).

Technical ops ask: please attach a sample of the usage profile per team (tokens/month) and the billing contact. I'll submit the approval ticket internally and draft a short term sheet.

Vanessa Ortiz
Programs Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: none

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava@pioneerlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental credits for Pioneer Labs founders cohort

Ava — attaching a short provisional term sheet and a one-page summary of the approval path. Vanessa: attached the usage CSV Ava sent and a proposed $8,000 top-up that splits the gap between $5k and $10k. Proposed terms: 90-day credit window, 30-day billing deferral, overages billed monthly. If Pioneer commits to a pilot conversion by Sept 1 (targeted minimum committed spend $2k/mo/org) we can extend a 45-day deferral and provide a 10% pilot discount on committed spend for months 1–2.

If that sounds ok I will: 1) submit the approval ticket, 2) route for finance sign-off, and 3) send a DocuSign-ready short terms doc to Pioneer.

Thanks — Mateo

Attachments: term_sheet_supplemental_v1.pdf (application/pdf); usage_snapshot_202705.csv (text/csv)

From: Ava Nguyen <ava@pioneerlabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pioneer Labs Legal <legal@pioneerlabs.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental credits for Pioneer Labs founders cohort

Thanks — this looks promising. Pioneer is comfortable with the $8k top-up and the 90-day window. We also accept the ramp-to-paid commitment; I pushed the commitment milestone to Sept 5 to align with cohort timelines.

Legal is cc'd for a quick review of the short term sheet — they prefer a single-line DocuSign. Billing contact is finance@pioneerlabs.com. If you can send the DocuSign link today we will try to turn it in by Friday.

Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to get teams onboarding.

Best,
Ava
